info.name: PDF Editor
info.summary: Read and edit PDF files in Nextcloud
info.description:
A native Nextcloud app for reading, organising and editing PDF documents, built on [PdfCraft](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft) - an open-source PDF workbench written from scratch in Rust.
**Supported format:** PDF
**Features:** - Read a PDF in a fast, native-feeling viewer - Reorder, rotate, insert, delete and extract pages - Combine several PDFs into one, and split one into several - Add, edit and remove text, shapes and images - Annotate and comment, and fill in forms - Sign, redact and protect a document - Recognise text (OCR) in a scan - Save your changes straight back to the file - Start page with your recent PDFs and a shortcut to open the Files app - Admin setting for the maximum file size - Dark and light themes, plus fullscreen mode - Responsive design that works on desktop and mobile
All rendering happens in the browser; the file never leaves the Nextcloud server except as the bytes the browser already has permission to read. See the [project README](https://github.com/ashcoft/nextcloud-pdf-editor#readme) for requirements, installation and usage.
